original.title: Stranded on a Dinosaur Island — Where Do You Spend the Night? 🏝️
original.banner: Pick your spot on the island
original.hook_vo: Jurassic islands, a warm lagoon. Pick your bed.
original.art_direction: Late Jurassic Solnhofen archipelago: pale turquoise brine lagoons, bleached limestone, sea-green night sky, coral-pink moon, 28mm.

options.label: Soft sand above the tide
options.vo: Soft sand, just above the tide.
options.image_prompt: POV on soft pale sand above the tideline of a Jurassic island beach at night, gentle surf, scrubby conifers behind, a coral-pink moon over the water, pale turquoise lagoon, bleached white limestone mud, sea-green night sky, coral-pink moonlight, 28mm lens, photoreal painterly, vertical composition, one warm focal light

options.label: Under scrubby conifers
options.vo: Under the scrubby conifers on the ridge.

options.label: On the warm lagoon flats
options.vo: Out on the warm lagoon flats.
options.image_prompt: An unoccupied natural-history landscape of a Late Jurassic shallow brine lagoon at night. The near foreground is milky turquoise ankle-shallow water flowing over smooth pale carbonate mud, tiny ripple ridges clearly visible beneath the water. The empty flat extends toward a thin distant limestone island on the right horizon. A small coral-pink moon lights a narrow reflection across the open lagoon. The view looks down across the empty shoreline, with only water, mineral sediment, distant low conifers and sky in the picture. Sea-green night sky, pale limestone, cool water, soft warm moon accent, photoreal painterly documentary landscape, vertical composition.
options.art_direction: Unoccupied natural-history environment of mineral ground and water with a warm coral-pink moon glow.

options.label: In a pterosaur roost
options.vo: Inside a pterosaur roost on the rocks.
options.image_prompt: Natural-history documentary portrait, tight side profile of the HEAD AND UPPER NECK ONLY of one living Rhamphorhynchus resting on a Late Jurassic limestone roost at night. Reconstruct the living head from the supplied fossil skull reference: a long very low narrow skull, long slender tapered jaws, interlocking forward-slanting needle teeth visible in a slightly open mouth, rounded low crown, one small dark eye far behind the long jaws. Intact grey-brown skin covers the skull and fine short grey-brown fibres cover the upper neck. The slender snout points right and fills most of the image width. Only the head and upper neck enter the frame; the lower neck continues beyond the left crop edge. The softly defocused lower background shows pale limestone roost stone; turquoise lagoon and sea-green night sky fill the upper background with a restrained coral-pink moon glow. Neutral readable documentary fill reveals the long toothed jaws and low skull geometry. Photoreal painterly living-animal reconstruction, vertical close portrait composition, quiet natural colours.
options.art_direction: Tight living Rhamphorhynchus head and upper-neck side profile, fossil-bound long low toothed jaws and uncrested rounded crown above softly defocused limestone and turquoise water

options.label: On a driftwood log
options.vo: Drifting on a big driftwood log.
options.image_prompt: An unoccupied bleached tree trunk floating diagonally across a Late Jurassic lagoon at night, seen from the shore. The thick natural driftwood log fills the lower left foreground and points toward a small distant limestone island. Its barkless pale wood, broken natural branches and uneven waterline are clearly visible. Turquoise ripples lap around the empty log. A small coral-pink moon and thin conifer island lie high in the background. Only natural driftwood, water, remote island and night sky occupy the frame. A warm coral-pink moon glow lights the upper wooden surface. Photoreal painterly nature-documentary still, vertical composition.
options.art_direction: Unoccupied natural-history environment of mineral ground and water with a warm coral-pink moon glow.

options.label: Dried lagoon mud
options.vo: Dead centre of the dried lagoon mud.
options.image_prompt: Ground-focused natural-history documentary detail of a half-dried Late Jurassic lagoon. Empty bleached carbonate mud forms irregular natural polygonal cracks across the near foreground, with dark wet turquoise clay visible inside a few narrow fissures. A shallow pool lies near the upper right edge, with a low limestone rim across the upper background. The mud surface is unmarked and undisturbed. The composition contains mineral ground, quiet water and a small strip of sea-green night sky only. One warm coral-pink moon glow accents the upper pool. Cool pale tones, neutral readable documentary fill, photoreal painterly vertical composition.
options.art_direction: Unoccupied natural-history environment of mineral ground and water with a warm coral-pink moon glow.

options.label: Wading out to the reef
options.vo: Wading out to the sponge reef.
options.image_prompt: Unoccupied water-level natural-history landscape looking across a Late Jurassic lagoon toward a low natural sponge reef. A few small rounded ochre sponge mounds emerge just above shallow turquoise water in the upper right midground, attached to pale limestone. Soft ripples fill the lower foreground, with gentle clear water revealing bare pale sediment underneath. The horizon is level, with distant low limestone islands and a small coral-pink moon. The scene contains only rippling water, attached simple sponges, mineral reef, distant island and sky. Sea-green night palette, restrained warm moon reflection, readable cool shadows, photoreal painterly documentary landscape, vertical composition.
options.art_direction: Unoccupied natural-history environment of mineral ground and water with a warm coral-pink moon glow.

options.label: Swim to the next island
options.vo: Swimming to the next island at night.
options.image_prompt: An unoccupied natural-history landscape of open deep Jurassic sea at night, viewed close to the dark water surface. Long smooth navy and deep teal ocean swells occupy almost the entire vertical picture. Foreground wave crests catch thin cool silver highlights. A tiny low limestone island lies far away on the high horizon, reduced by distance to a narrow silhouette. A small coral-pink moon makes a restrained warm focal glow and broken reflection across the distant sea. The view contains only deep open water, remote island and sea-green night sky. The broad uninterrupted water surface has a clear deep-water character. Photoreal painterly documentary landscape, vertical composition, readable cool midtones with restrained warm moonlight.
options.art_direction: Empty deep open water with rolling dark teal waves and one tiny distant island under a small coral-pink moon.

original.verdict_vo: Real answer: number 2, because the drying lagoons left sticky mud that trapped insects and small dinosaurs. Stay on firm ground.

fact.text: The Solnhofen lagoons at times almost dried out, exposing sticky carbonate mud that trapped insects and a few small dinosaurs.
fact.source_sentence: At times, the lagoons almost dried out, exposing sticky carbonate muds that trapped insects and a few small dinosaurs.

original.description:
A Late Jurassic island chain in what is now Germany, with warm lagoons that look perfect for the night. Eight choices, from a conifer ridge to a swim in open water.

Head geometry reference: Rhamphorhynchus specimen from Solnhofen, photo Dean Falk Schnabel, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Rhamphorhynchus_muensteri_fossil.jpg, CC0 (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), cropped fossil reference used for AI adaptation, living animal, colour and setting are illustrative.
original.related_topic_hint: The Ocean Before the Dinosaurs / Jurassic seas
